correctness.rationale: Exact finite-grid jump decomposition reduces the norm to jump variations. Binomial arithmetic proves prefix bound and an interior plateau. The 2012 primary source supplies the verified denominator lower bound; direct square-reciprocal estimates control its inverse. Uniform Abel estimates for alternating prefix tails lead to an L1 derivative approximation with n,j-independent error; averaging |cos(pi x)| yields the sharp 2/pi coefficient. Finite exact-rational identities and quadrature corroborated the proof but are not used as universal certificates.

value.rationale: Floater–Hormann degree controls polynomial reproduction and approximation order, while prior Lebesgue bounds increase with d. Establishing that the sharp leading BV instability is nevertheless identical for every fixed positive d, with a complete asymptotic boundary-sensitive jump profile and extremal central jumps, resolves a motivated stability question over infinitely many distinct interpolation orders. It is not a small arbitrary parameter slice or a known-table recomputation.
